label: Earlier selection and later non-progression
interpretive_limit: Chronology establishes a change, not its cause.

label: No located completed Love appointment
interpretive_limit: Missing instrument is not proof none existed; Cook acceptance is a different person.

label: Ministerial appointment and Council chair election are distinct
interpretive_limit: APH is an administrative stage, not the statutory appointing person.

label: Practical concerns prepared before planned meeting
interpretive_limit: Briefing does not prove delivery of its contents.

label: Later attributed public criticism
interpretive_limit: Subsequent explanation is not contemporaneous decision evidence.

label: Favourable institutional review
interpretive_limit: May assessment and June final report differ; prior ministerial receipt not established.

label: Conditional procedural fairness
interpretive_limit: No general entitlement to renewal or proven absence of response opportunity.

label: Existing functions versus proposed powers
interpretive_limit: Proposed legislation is distinct from decision-date law.

label: Continued cultural-safety work
interpretive_limit: Publication-law transition does not establish abandonment or use of proposed direction powers.

label: Contrasting training evidence
interpretive_limit: Standardised-patient experience and clinical diabetes outcomes differ; US intervention combined training and feedback.

label: Specific reasons and proportionate safeguards
interpretive_limit: Normative proposals, not findings of unlawful conduct.

label: Institutional signalling risk
interpretive_limit: Plausible interpretation, not demonstrated effect; contrary continuation evidence retained.

label: Review, audit and conciliation mechanisms
interpretive_limit: Not asserted to be prerequisites to non-reappointment.
